commit_details.title: 🔧 Реализация системы контроля миграции в PostgreSQL и обновление документации - 2025-09-02
commit_details.description: Полная реализация системы контроля миграции в PostgreSQL с 26 таблицами, триггерами, функциями PL/pgSQL и обновлением всей документации проекта

implementation_summary.inheritance_system: PostgreSQL INHERITS for MS SQL and PostgreSQL objects
implementation_summary.many_to_many_relationships: Through mapping tables with automatic control

documentation_updates.project.md: Added comprehensive section about migration control system
documentation_updates.changelog.md: Added version 1.0.4 with full implementation details
documentation_updates.migration-control-system.md: Updated to version 2.0 with implementation status
documentation_updates.table_comments: All 26 tables have detailed comments explaining their purpose

technical_features.automatic_uniqueness_control: Triggers for table-problem and column-problem uniqueness
technical_features.problem_solution_management: One-to-many relationship between problems and solutions

workflow_implementation.default_solution_assignment: 'способ решения не определен' assigned by default
workflow_implementation.solution_replacement: Replace with specific solutions as they are determined
workflow_implementation.uniqueness_control: Automatic control through triggers on every operation

next_steps: System is ready for use in MS SQL → PostgreSQL migration process

Ready for integration with migration workflow

summary: Successfully synchronized project with GitHub. The migration control system has been fully implemented in PostgreSQL with 26 tables, triggers, PL/pgSQL functions, and comprehensive documentation. All changes have been committed and pushed to the feature/mssql-migration branch. The system is ready for use in controlling the MS SQL to PostgreSQL migration process.
